description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ratmalana, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520002 (23/0574)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and legal encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership determinations for specific properties in Ratmalana and Attidiya South, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
